Stephen.text: Apple announces a Mac with a touch screen
Stephen.full-pick-text: Apple announces a Mac with a touch screen. It is an update to an existing notebook. macOS does not radically change to accommodate touch. The product comes with the Apple Polishing Cloth in the box.
Stephen.notes:
• "It is an update to an existing notebook." (in other words, not a new line like "MacBook Touch")
  • "macOS does not radically change to accommodate touch." (Specifically, the macOS on this machine does not have a custom UI compared to a non-touch Mac.)
  • "The product comes with the Apple Polishing Cloth in the box."

Federico.text: The new M5 Max chip in the MacBook Pro comes with a new architecture that...
Federico.full-pick-text: The new M5 Max chip in the MacBook Pro comes with a new architecture that better separates CPU and GPU inside the chip, allows Apple to advertise higher sustained performance and better heat dissipation, and allows for more than two configuration options for M5 Max
Federico.notes:
• "Better separates CPU and GPU inside the chip"
    • Ungraded: something like a 2.5D chiplet design
  • "Allows Apple to advertise higher sustained performance and better heat dissipation"
  • "Allows for more than two configuration options for M5 Max"
    • These must be CPU/GPU options, not other things in the SOC like RAM
